request.text: Don't look so surprised. Did you think I'd let you carry it alone? A frame. You'll know one when you see it. No more burning towns. I made my first camp by a lake, under three pines. I'd like to see it again. She can't hear me. Only you can. Half-blind, then. As I've always been. Walk, little light.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a light northern English accent. Male, 60-70. Excellent quality. Persona: an old wanderer who has walked the roads all his life. Emotion: warm, wry, tired. A low, weathered, slightly gravelly voice with dry humour under it. Speaks unhurried and close, like a man talking across a campfire at night, in short sentences with small pauses.
